In its announcement regarding the establishment of the team, the Ministry of Health stated that as part of reviews and lessons-learned, it found that the framework has value in easing workload pressures, but at the same time, claims were raised by some stakeholders within the system regarding harm to the quality of training and care, to continuity of treatment, and to the functioning of the departments in which the framework is applied, creating significant disparities in these areas between peripheral hospitals and those in central Israel. The team is scheduled to submit its recommendations by May 1, 2026.
